bug_report_content:
Title: Problem with polymorphic types, losing properties from base type(s)
State: closed

Description:
(background, see: https://github.com/dropwizard/dropwizard/pull/1449)

Looks like sub-type resolution may be broken for one particular case: that of using `defaultImpl`. If so, appears like properties from super-types are not properly resolved; guessing this could be follow-up item for #1083 (even sooner than I thought...).

Comments:

[cowtowncoder]: While this could be related to #1128 that issue has now been resolved and there's no reproduction, so closing for now.

[cowtowncoder]: Second try: guessing this is related to handling of `StdSubtypeResolver`.
